specs.Item Highlight: High Speed Printing 3D Printer PLA Filament,Designed for Fast Printing

features: Print Faster: eSUN Fast Printing Speedy PLA Filament, designed for High Speed 3D Printers. Under same model and printing time, the printing speed of this PLA are equivalent to 6 times ordinary PLA which print at normal speed.

Wide Compatibility: Perfectly compatible with most 1.75mm FDM 3D printers on the market, such as:Bambu Lab P1P / X1 / X1C, AnkerMake M5, Creality K1 / K1 Max, Voron 2.4, FLSUN V400, Prusa, UltiMaker, MK3, Ender 3, MakerBot, Flashforge, Raise3D. Widly used in machinery, electronic appliances, automobiles, decorations, COSPLAY and other items.

Clog-free & Bubble-Free & Less-tangle: Full mechanical winding and strict manual examination ensure tangling free and avoid filament breaking and snapping.eSUN PLA filament does not overlap or tangle, no clogging and no cracking, extremely high successful rate, resulting in printed parts that have an outstanding smooth and stable surface finish.

Dimensional Accuracy & Consistency: Dimensional Tolerance +/- 0.03mm. PLA 3D printer filaments are produced with more precise specification. Minimum tolerance and low warping to ensure consistent feeding and stable prints, no bubbles, less stringing, extremely high successful rate.

100% Vacuumed Sealed Packaging: Complete drying for 24 hours before packaging, eSUN filament comes in a sealed vacuum bag with a desiccant bag to keep it dry and prevent from dust and foreign particles, avoid nozzle jams and yield smooth 3D models.
description: What is eSUN High Speed PLA Filament? Improved and upgraded based on ordinary PLA (Polylactic Acid), eSUN fast printing speedy PLA keeping all the advantages of PLA, easy to print just like ordinary PLA. Designed for high speed printers. Fast cooling with high speed printing and comes out with high printing quality. Continues consistently outstanding performance at high speeds.
